title: Tizen OS for TV Device
description: The TV development profile in Tizen (used from version 8.0 onward) is tailored for smart television and set-top box devices, supporting web and .NET application types and optimized for large-screen, remote-control interactions, media playback and UI navigation. Developers targeting this profile benefit from device-specific APIs for TV features (e.g., screen groups, input devices, display rotation) and an ecosystem designed around consumer living-room experiences and content-rich environments.
